answer_summary: 3 CH2(COOH)2 + 4 BrO3^- -> 9 CO2 + 4 Br^- + 6 H2O, with Ce(IV) as a zero-net-consumption catalyst; equivalently 4 KBrO3 gives 4 KBr in the molecular form.
assumptions: The printed formula CH2(COOH)2 is parsed as C3H4O4.
Chemical equations conserve each element and total electric charge.
A catalyst has zero net stoichiometric consumption in an overall reaction.
